By drawing parallels between the teachings of the Ahlulbayt and the tragic events of Karbala, the lecture highlights how true devotion requires absolute reliance on God and the recognition of the Imam of the time.

The session explores deep theological concepts, including the creation of the universe from the light of the Ahlul-Bayt and the significance of the Pen and Tablet. It emphasizes the necessity of Wilayat for spiritual guidance and concludes with the announcement of quiz winners and prayers for the reappearance of Imam Mahdi (a.s.).

chapters.title: Virtues and Truth of the Ahlul-Bayt
The Creation and Purpose of the Pen
The Knowledge of the Pen and Imams

title: Imam Reza (a.s.) - Har Zabaan Ke Maalik | Wilaadat Ba'saadat-e-Imam Raza (a.s.)
excerpt: This lecture discusses the miraculous ability of Imam Reza (a.s.) to communicate with people in their native languages and dialects. It highlights a narration by Abu Salt al-Harawi, where the Imam explains that as the Hujjah (Proof) of Allah, he must possess the knowledge of all languages to guide creation. The talk concludes with a prayer for the reappearance of Imam Mahdi (a.t.f.s.) and for believers to be granted spiritual wisdom.

title: Maanga Hua Paani Humein Peena Nahin Aata | Ustaad-ush-Shoara Marhoom Ahsan Danapuri Sahab
excerpt: This lecture reflects on the poignant final moments of Imam Hussain's son, Ali Asghar, during the tragedy of Karbala. It highlights the profound suffering of the infant who was denied water and the metaphorical depth of his inability to drink. The discourse emphasizes the emotional weight of this historical event through the lens of poetic tradition.

title: Majlis 8 | Deen Ka Dushman Kaun? - Part 2 | Dr. Shabeeb Rizvi
excerpt: In this lecture, Dr. Shabeeb Rizvi explores the identity of the enemies of the faith and the importance of aligning one's intellect with the teachings of the Ahlulbayt. He emphasizes that true belief requires identifying and rejecting evil, maintaining unwavering loyalty to Imam Hussain (a.s.), and avoiding the path of hypocrisy. The discourse highlights the spiritual dangers of harboring enmity toward Ali (a.s.) and underscores the necessity of steadfastness in the face of societal and political pressures.

chapters.title: Inheritance and Loyalty to Imam Hussain (a.s.)
Religion vs. Superstition and Political Division
The True Followers of the Ahlulbayt
The Nature of Hypocrisy and Loyalty
The Status of Nasibis and the Love of Ali
The Tragedy of Karbala and Ali Akbar

title: Majlis 2 | Aql aur Aaqil | Dr. Shabeeb Rizvi | #Muharram 2026
excerpt: In this lecture, Dr. Shabeeb Rizvi explores the profound relationship between intellect (Aql) and the spiritual path of the believer, using the martyrdom of Hur ibn Yazid al-Riyahi as a primary example of divine guidance. The discourse defines true intellect as a tether that controls base desires and emphasizes the necessity of aligning one's words with righteous deeds. Through Quranic insights and the teachings of the Ahlulbayt, the lecture highlights the importance of humility, reflective speech, and preparation for the afterlife while avoiding worldly distractions.

They reveal that three specific deeds are the most beneficial for attaining rewards in the afterlife. The speaker emphasizes the spiritual significance of these actions for every believer.

title: Ask anything from your Imam
excerpt: This lecture recounts a miraculous event involving Imam Hasan al-Askari (a.s.) and his companion, Abu Hashim al-Ja'fari. While imprisoned, Abu Hashim received a divine promise of release from the Imam, which manifested exactly as predicted. The story highlights the Imam's omniscience and his compassionate nature, encouraging believers to approach the Ahlulbayt with their needs without hesitation or shame.

chapters.title: The Miracle of Imam Hasan al-Askari

title: Shameem -e- Ma'refat | Ep.#7 | Truth is the Criterion, Not Personalities  |  Dr. Shabeeb Rizvi
excerpt: In this lecture, Dr. Shabeeb Rizvi emphasizes that truth, rather than personalities, must be the ultimate criterion for spiritual recognition and guidance. He explores the central role of the Ahlulbayt as the 'Ark of Salvation' and the 'Gate of Repentance,' urging believers to prioritize divine truth over historical figures or charismatic leaders. The discussion highlights the necessity of absolute submission to the Imam's guidance and warns against the dangers of personality worship and historical inconsistency.

excerpt: This webinar session explores the essential etiquette, or Adab, required when engaging with the Holy Quran. It emphasizes that proper conduct and spiritual preparation are vital for a meaningful connection with the divine text, covering both physical requirements like Wudu and the importance of respectful posture. The lecture also addresses practical questions regarding digital versus physical copies of the Quran and highlights the significance of reciting with sincerity and beauty.

The speaker highlights a specific confession concerning the investigation of the house of Fatimah (s.a.) as evidence that an aggressive confrontation occurred. By analyzing this historical account, the lecture argues that the regret itself serves as proof of the events that transpired at the door of the Prophet's daughter.

chapters.title: Analyzing the Regret of Abu Bakr

title: EP09 | Marefat-e-Imam (a.s.) Ki Zaroorat | ITMAAM-E-HUJJAT
excerpt: This lecture explores the theological necessity of recognizing the Imam of the time, emphasizing that such recognition is a fundamental obligation for every believer. It details the critical attributes of an Imam, including divine appointment, absolute infallibility (Ma'sum), and superior knowledge, which are essential for guiding the community. The session warns that failing to recognize the Imam leads to a state of spiritual ignorance, or Jahiliyyah, and underscores the Imam's role as the ultimate representative of God on earth.

He emphasizes that a true bond is reflected in the alignment of one's emotional state with the joys and sorrows of the Ahlul-Bayt. By prioritizing the Imam's happiness over personal struggles, a believer demonstrates the depth of their faith and devotion.

chapters.title: Signs of Connection to the Imam

The talk emphasizes that supporting the oppressed is incomplete without defending the rights of Bibi Fatima, as her curse carries eternal consequences for those who wronged her.

excerpt: This lecture explores the theological connection between the People of the Cave (Ashab-e-Kahf) and the reappearance of Imam Mahdi (a.t.f.s.). The speaker explains that these individuals are destined to awaken upon the arrival of Imam Mahdi to testify to his mission and greet him.

chapters.title: The Return of the People of the Cave

The talk further explains that belief must be established before the Imam's reappearance to be spiritually valid, referencing Quranic verses regarding the signs of Allah.

chapters.title: The Consequence of Denying Imam Mahdi

title: Allah Ne Imam Reza (a.s.) Ka Naam Reza Kyun Rakha? [ENG SUBS]
excerpt: This lecture clarifies the divine origin of the title 'Al-Riza' given to the eighth Imam, Ali ibn Musa al-Riza (a.s.). Imam Muhammad al-Taqi (a.s.) explains that the name was not chosen by the Caliph Ma'mun, but was divinely ordained because the Imam was pleasing to Allah and His Messenger. Furthermore, the title is unique among the Imams because both his friends and his enemies were satisfied with his character and conduct.

chapters.title: The Divine Origin of the Name Riza

The discussion culminates in the broader context of Ghadir Khumm, framing the appointment of Imam Ali (a.s.) as a central pillar of Islamic faith and divine guidance.

The speaker cites prominent Sunni scholars and historians, such as Ibn Khallikan, Ali ibn al-Athir, and Sibt ibn al-Jawzi, to provide evidence that the birth of the 12th Imam is acknowledged in classical Sunni texts. Additionally, the session serves as an episode of the 'Panah-e-Kainat' series, which includes a quiz competition aimed at encouraging deeper study of Islamic history.

The speaker encourages believers to participate fully in the rituals of Azadari without hesitation, emphasizing that these acts are a collection of all goodness.

title: EP3 |  Maula Ali (a.s.) Ka Shura Ke Khilaaf Ehtejaaj | GHADEER PAYMAAN-E-ILAAHI MEGA QUIZ 2026

The speaker argues that the Shura contradicted the divine appointment of Imam Ali (a.s.) established at Ghadir-e-Khumm and highlights how Imam Ali's participation was a strategic move to expose the process rather than an endorsement. By referencing historical texts like 'Al-Kamil fi al-Tarikh', the lecture details the political maneuvering and the specific virtues of Imam Ali (a.s.) that were suppressed by the committee members.

title: EP#14: Inteqaam Nahin To Haadesa Nahin – Ek Ajeeb E’teraaz

The speaker refutes this logic by providing historical precedents where prophets and Imams chose patience over revenge despite clear instances of oppression. By citing examples like Prophet Adam (a.s.), the martyrdom of Janabe Hamza, and the Prophet's (s.a.w.a.) treatment of his enemies, the lecture demonstrates that lack of revenge does not equate to the non-existence of an event. Ultimately, the speaker emphasizes that patience in the face of injustice does not absolve the oppressors of their crimes.

The speaker argues that the demolition was driven by deep-seated envy and hatred toward the Ahlul-Bayt, rather than genuine theological concerns regarding innovation. By highlighting the sacred figures buried there and the Prophet's own reverence for the site, the lecture calls for the eventual restoration of these shrines under the leadership of Imam Mahdi.

title: Dua-e-Iftetaah: Importance & Dua with English & Urdu Translation | Shaikh Maitham al-Najafi
excerpt: This lecture explores the spiritual significance and structure of Dua-e-Iftitah, a prominent supplication recited during the nights of Ramadan. Shaikh Maitham al-Najafi explains that the prayer was narrated by the second deputy of Imam Mahdi and serves as a profound tool for recognizing Allah's attributes and mercy. The talk breaks down the supplication into its three core components: praise of God, salutations upon the Prophet and the Ahlulbayt, and a heartfelt plea for the reappearance of the Imam to establish justice.

title: Mazloomiyyat e Ali (a.s.) | Majlis#02 | Maulana Meesam Zaidi Sahab | Majaalis e Azaa e Ali (a.s.)

The speaker emphasizes that the path is intrinsically linked to the recognition and Wilayah of the Imams, particularly Imam Ali (a.s.). By following their guidance in this world, believers prepare themselves to traverse the bridge of the Hereafter, ensuring their salvation.

title: Unka Naqeeb Kaun Aur Hamara Khateeb Kaun? | Maulana Meesam Zaidi Sahab Ka Aham Paighaam
excerpt: Maulana Meesam Zaidi discusses a historical narration found in the works of Nasir al-Din al-Albani regarding the Prophet's daughter and the implications of his teachings. The lecture highlights the lack of courage among some scholars to publicly acknowledge historical truths that contradict their established narratives. The speaker emphasizes the importance of speaking the truth, even when it is controversial or risks offending others.

title: Importance of Acquiring Knowledge | English Lecture | Session #1 | Dr. Shabeeb Rizvi
excerpt: This lecture by Dr. Shabeeb Rizvi explores the profound significance of acquiring knowledge within the Islamic tradition, emphasizing its role as a prerequisite for faith and spiritual enlightenment. The session highlights how knowledge serves as both a protective guide and a source of divine excellence, distinguishing it from mere information. By drawing on Quranic teachings and the wisdom of the Ahlulbayt, the lecture underscores that true knowledge illuminates the intellect and directs human actions toward salvation.

title: Dua-e-Jaushan-e-Kabeer Ka Sawaab Likhte Likhte Farishte Thak Jaate Hain
excerpt: This lecture highlights the immense spiritual rewards associated with reciting Dua-e-Jaushan-e-Kabeer, particularly during the month of Ramadan. The Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.) explains that reciting this supplication even once grants the believer protection from Hellfire and secures their entry into Paradise. Furthermore, the recitation leads to divine guardianship, where angels are appointed to protect the believer from sin and calamity throughout their life.

title: EP04 | Bay'at-e-Ghadeer | 💐 GHADEER: PAYMAAN-E-ILAAHI MEGA QUIZ 2024💐
excerpt: This lecture explores the profound significance of the event of Ghadir Khumm, focusing on the divine command for the pledge of allegiance (Bay'ah) to Imam Ali (a.s.). It details the authenticity of the Ghadir sermon, the necessity of Wilayah for the completion of faith, and the eternal nature of the Imamate chain. The session emphasizes the duty of believers to uphold this covenant, recognize the Ahlul-Bayt, and propagate the message of Ghadir as a core component of religious practice.
